body: The easiest way to serve AI apps and models - Build Model Inference APIs, Job queues, LLM apps, Multi-model pipelines, and more!
plain_description: **Turn AI models into services your business can run.** Build inference APIs and deploy models in Docker or Kubernetes. BentoML also helps manage dependencies and improve serving efficiency.
technical_description: BentoML is a Python library for building online serving systems for AI applications and model inference. It turns model inference code into REST API servers, packages code, models, and dependencies into deployable Bentos, and supports Docker and Kubernetes deployment. Serving features include dynamic batching, model parallelism, multi-stage pipelines, and multi-model inference graphs.
title: BentoML
